outcome: CP types (hemiplegia, diplegia, tetraplegia, dyskinetic CP, ataxia)
Neuroimaging findings (maldevelopment, white matter lesions, cortical/subcortical lesions, basal ganglia lesions)
cohort: The study included 104,713 live births in western Sweden between 2007 and 2010.
finding: The crude prevalence of cerebral palsy was 1.96 per 1000 live births, showing a non-significant decrease in term-born children, with hemiplegia remaining the most prevalent CP type and dyskinetic CP decreasing.
